summary: Discussion snapshot: vendor agent launches & security incidents (OpenAI Dots, training pause), Anthropic model update, multiple user-field reports on coding-agent tooling, and infra primitives (jev, MCP) surfacing. | Vendor-only sweep: product releases and infra updates from Cloudflare, AWS, OpenAI, Anthropic, JetBrains, Modal, E2B; plus a critical LiteLLM GHSA. Missing social/operator reports in this shard. | GitHub snapshot: multiple mainstream agent/platform releases (Langfuse, Microsoft Agent Framework, Vercel agent-browser, Bytedance deer-flow) plus rising infra primitives for agent memory and cost tracking; lacking social/operator reports for workflow signals. | Package shard: mix of vendor-backed VS Code/npm/Docker packages (OpenAI, Amazon, Salesforce) and emerging agent infra (MCP, memory, detection). Missing social/operator field reports for usage patterns.
